heading: cyHardship
questionTitle: cyWill a rent increase on the proposed start date cause you hardship?
introParagraph1: cyIf the tribunal agrees with the landlord's proposed market rent, it can delay the new rent date if it thinks you will experience hardship.
introParagraph2: cyIf you want the tribunal to delay the new rent date, you must provide full details of your financial circumstances.

rentIncreaseHardshipDetails.label: cyTell us how you would experience financial hardship if the rent was increased on the proposed start date (optional)
rentIncreaseHardshipDetails.hint: cyYou can upload any supporting evidence next

rentIncreaseCauseHardship.required: cySelect whether you think a rent increase on the proposed start date will cause you hardship

rentIncreaseHardshipDetails.invalid: cyExplanation must be 500 characters or less
